cells.gaps: The latest figure, 78.2 per cent for 2025 by INE's national survey, is below 80 per cent.
cells.note: INE's 2025 survey puts mobile phone ownership at 78.2 per cent of people aged 10 and over (CPV-006), up from 76.3 per cent in 2024. It is past two in three and below the 80 per cent line.
